scheme_name: Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category
Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a college student
Applicant must meet the income limit prescribed under the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
Applicant must be residing outside their native city or village
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly housing allowance of ₹2,000 in divisional headquarters, ₹1,250 in other district headquarters, and ₹1,000 in tehsil/development block headquarters.
